nom: NUDESTIX NUDESKIN Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt

avis.texte: I like the brand. I was hopeful for this product. It works great, but it irritates/burns the eyes and it takes a bit to clear out.
The smell is incredibly overpowering and burns my eyes. It does take off all makeup even full glam but there are cheaper and better cleansing balms out there that don't burn.
This product worked great. It was a bit too oily for my skin but it removes makeup easily and I would use again!
I love to use this product when I wear a lot of makeup. It removes makeup efficiently. The smell is lovely. I love the packaging.
Great for senistive skin easy way to remove makeup without the harsh rubbing

avis.titre: Is a good product but sadly dont recommended for oily skin
avis.texte: I'm a girl with oily skin I use the product before wash my face .Smells like plants smell good but the texture is like a wax I don't recommend this product if u have oily skin

avis.titre: Effectively melts makeup if that's what you need!
avis.texte: This has a lovely botanical scent which I loved but might not be the best choice for sensitive skin. Its thick texture really does melt makeup off but like many others it did sting my eyes slightly. Basically this is a solid choice for those in need of heavy-duty makeup removal especially if you love a botanical scent. However if you have sensitive skin or don't wear heavy makeup regularly you might want to explore other options. It all comes down to personal preference and what your skin needs!

avis.titre: Effective Makeup Melt But Use with Caution Around Eyes
avis.texte: I've been using the Nudeskin Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt for a while now and it truly excels at what it's designed to do: melting makeup away with ease. This balm turns into a luxurious oil that effortlessly dissolves even the most stubborn waterproof makeup leaving my skin feeling clean and nourished.However I did experience a significant downside. Despite being careful to avoid my eye area I felt a burning sensation in my eyes during use. This was quite uncomfortable although it didn't cause any visible irritation. Because of this I would advise anyone with sensitive eyes to proceed with caution.Overall if you're looking for a powerful makeup remover that can clear everything off your face at the end of the day this could be a great choice just be mindful of its potential near the eyes. It's nearly perfect but not quite there yet which is why I'm giving it four stars.
This is a really great cleansing balm my makeup comes off quick & easy. Nice smell with a creamy texture.
I love the smell! It also easily removes my mascaras and waterproof liners. Matte lipstick is also easily removed.
Cleans even the depth of your pores lol. Excellent smell to be honest and I didn't like too much the texture but that's my problem. Rest was great. Didn't have any breakouts afterwards
I like this product to use before my second cleanser. It does irritate eyes though.

pretty good cleansing balm! i like the smell to it and it didn't irritate my skin or eyes. also there was barely any eye fog! it got 99% of my makeup off the first time. deducted a star because of the packaging i like it as a tube but its like a metal tube so it looses it shape and kinda hard to squeeze sometimes

avis.titre: Gentle and effective! If you enjoy melt!
avis.texte: Easy to useSnell greatGreat PackagingEffective Gentle on the skin

avis.titre: Works Great.... and smells good too!
avis.texte: Used product to remove my makeup. A little goes a long way to effectively remove my makeup thoroughly cleansing my skin without drying it out. Loved the fresh fragrance

avis.titre: Easiest removal of mascara for me
avis.texte: This is the first time I've ever used something like this before and received a free sample in exchange for my honest review. It has a waxy type consistency but ends up feeling so lightweight on my skin. I had a full face of makeup and it completely melted the mascara off my eyelashes. I actually was so impressed how easily it came off and it may be the easiest removal I've ever had of mascara. I did look like a raccoon for a hot second but once I did the rinse off with warm water it came right off. It does warn you that it can irritate your eyes and to be careful right in the instructions so if your eyes are sensitive this may not be as useful as it was for me. The eyes are my most heavily made up area so I would need something that wouldn't irritate me. My eyes were personally unaffected by it so I really enjoyed it. Citrusy smell to it which I found pleasant but not necessary either that I think maybe without the fragrance it might not irritate others as much. Overall such a cool concept to melt off your makeup and I personally would buy again.

avis.titre: could be irritating for those with sensitive skin
avis.texte: i used this product to take off my makeup in a two step cleansing routine. you will definitely have to use a face wash after this. it's heavily fragranced and was irritating for my sensitive skin. it works just like any other makeup melt. if you like perfumes then you'll love this

It's a great face wash to add to your routine as a second cleanser after removing all your makeup. I personally love it first thing in the morning because it wakes me up and wakes up my skin with it's bright citrusy scent.
Small package but really powerful you dont have to use a lot. I love that I can carry it with me everywhere

avis.titre: Removes makeup but burns eyes and strong scent
avis.texte: Does a good job of removing face and eye makeup HOWEVER with all the other options on the market that are not heavily fragrances and DO NOT burn I would pass on this. This leaves such a strong stinging sensation in the eyes and it smells like orang/ lemon cleaning products.

This product has been great! It clears my makeup off so easily and literally gets most of it off! It's got a great consistency so it's not super thick but it's also not watery. It's smells Devine! I could literally just sniff it all day. It really is the best cleansing balms I've ever used. I would definitely recommend it to everyone!

avis.titre: Great Concept That Has Room for Improvement
avis.texte: The Nudestix Citrus Clean Balm & Makeup-Up Melt is a great concept that has room for improvement. To start off I loved how well it worked at removing all of the dirt oils sunscreen and makeup that was on my skin - I didn't have much if anything left to remove with my water based cleanser after! It also had a nice fresh scent that reminded me of a freshly squeezed iced glass of orange juice. The downside of the scent; however is that it's scented with a lot of essential oil ingredients which might've been the cause for how badly it hurt when I cleansed my eye area - it made my eyes sting and hurt for what felt like a long time. Overall while I do love how well it worked I just wish that it was formulated a bit differently to not sting eyes and to be better for sensitive skin types. I think that it would work great as a general oil based facial cleanser rather than for use in the immediate eye area.

avis.titre: Smells amazing and removes makeup but stings eyes
avis.texte: The smell is AMAZING with a refreshing citrusy smell- which makes it very pleasant to use this balm. And for this reason I will continue using it. It does seem effective at removing makeup- however the big issue with this balm is that when you try to take off your eye makeup it causes eye stinging unlike other balms I've used. Also when compared to my Clinique balm the consistency of this balm is much thicker which makes it harder to use. My main purpose when using makeup removers is also removing eye makeup- so the eye stinging makes this product not so useful. I will be using for just cleansing my face from time to time but will stick to my Clinique balm.
Leaves your face squeaky clean really gets the job done a little goes a long way!

I was gifted the Nudestix citrus clean balm & makeup melt for my option and review. This is a really great cleansing balm my makeup just evaporates. It smells absolutely amazing and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean.
I was pleasantly surprised by this stuff! It removed my makeup well without leaving my skin stripped feeling! Didn't break out my extremely sensitive skin and appreciate the smell wasn't offensive!
It's really nice the smell but I didn't like how oily it made my skin feel

avis.titre: Great product and I would recommend
avis.texte: Great product and I have sensitive skin but it didn't irritate me.

avis.titre: This smells absolutely divine! It makes my skin feel so so n
avis.texte: I absolutely love the texture of this product! I also really like the smell. I did not think that I would enjoy it but I I found that the orange essential oil smell is absolutely invigorating. It feels decadent when you put it on your skin.
Melts like butter and dissolves all the makeup and dirt with it. Didn't leave the skin dry. Like it!

I was pleasantly surprised by how much I like this balm. I have never used a makeup remover balm so I can't compare it to anything else but it has a great scent and makes my skin feel clean and fresh after. I avoided using this around my eyes because it does cause some sensitivity. I have noticed an improvement in my skin since using it.

avis.titre: Works great just don't use it on your eyes!
avis.texte: While I loved this for cleaning most of my makeup off I discovered pretty quickly that I cannot use this on my eye makeup as it causes my eyes to burn pretty badly. For me when using cleansing balm my goal is to use one product to remove all of my makeup. Unfortunately this means that I have to use two products while removing my makeup. This is the only downside to me though as it does work extremely well and I love the smell! The tube is also lovely so I don't have to dip my hand into a jar like so many other cleansing balms!

I enjoyed trying this makeup remover balm as it has been so different than anything else I have tried. I can see how this would be easy to travel with not being a liquid.It has a great citrus clean scent but the texture at first is harder then melts with your body temperature to an oil based remover. I used it as a step 1 before my normal evening skincare routine.I did notice a little redness to my eye the next Morning but unsure if this is related. I like it and would recommend but not sure if this has been my favorite product for removing makeup.

I won't say it is my all time favorite cleansing balm the scent is light which I appreciate as I do not like scented products. It does clean my face and the texture was thick but smooth. I can see this for more heavy duty than my normal day-to-day makeup

avis.titre: Smells lovely great first step cleanser
avis.texte: I use this as a first step cleanser it's good for taking everything off except the eye area. Keep it away from the eyes it'll burn because it has scent!

Overall I didn't dislike this product but it also didn't really do anything for me. While it contributed to getting my makeup off I didn't really feel like it melted it off. I would rather use the cerave makeup balm for probably a cheaper price. I don't mind it for my face makeup but for my eye makeup it didn't really help take it off at all in terms of mascara. But I liked the texture and it didn't disturb my skin at all. But just wouldn't necessarily recommend it.

I received this NudeSkin Clean balm and makeup melt. I love the way this smells. It smells so refreshing. The texture is nice and it melts my makeup right off This cleansing balm is easy to use and very effective. I would recommend to anyone who uses makeup throughout the day.

I wish the packaging was different because it's hard to get some of the product out without ruining the tube. I really enjoyed the smell of the rosehip oil. It's has an oily feeling when you work it down to melt. It got all my makeup and I felt moisturized.

The Nudestix Nudeskin Citrus Clean Balm & Makeup Melt is a game-changer! Its refreshing citrus scent is invigorating and it effortlessly melts away makeup leaving my skin feeling clean and hydrated. Plus its natural ingredients make it gentle on my skin. Definitely a must-have in my skincare routine!

The smell is a powerful fragrance in this balmy textured makeup remover. Easily lathers up removing the makeup from your skin doesn't take long or much to get the job done. Be careful around the eyes I think something a little lighter would be better for eye makeup removal but this works wonders for stubborn foundation.

Nudeskin Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt is a total game-changer for me! It effortlessly wipes away makeup leaving my skin feeling refreshed and oh-so-nourished. Plus the citrus extracts give it this amazing burst of freshness that I absolutely love. And let's not forget about the convenience factor - perfect for travel or on-the-go touch-ups. It's seriously a must-have in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: I love this stuff! It smells so good!
avis.texte: I love this stuff it smells so good! It takes my makeup off and leaves my skin feeling super fresh and clean.
I love how the product has all the combinations for makeup removal. It works great and has nice smell.

avis.titre: Must have for our night time routine
avis.texte: I like the smell of citrus and how easy it melts on my skin. It didn't take away my mascara completely
The smell of this product is truly amazing. I wish it was a candle because I would burn it continuously. It's a thick product and it does a great job melting off your makeup as marketed.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. With that being said it was not my favorite. I didn't like the packaging it felt like the ones medicine ointment comes in (maybe its a good thing to get most of the product out?). It was a bit too citrus-y. It kind of reminded me of an all purpose cleaner lol. It did an ok job of taking my makeup off. I don't wear a full face though (tinted moisturizer concealer blush) so I am not sure how this will work with full coverage makeup. I think it did leave my skin looking hydrated. I will continue to use it but I probably would not purchase.

This was great I love the smell. I know some people might not like the fragrance cause it's strong .but I did. I also love that its easy to use a small amount goes a long way .and it got off all my stubborn makeup and left my face feeling clean .

avis.titre: New addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: At the end of the day I put a small amount onto my fingertips and massage onto my dry face. Then I rinse with warm water. I follow up with my moisturizer.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again !
avis.texte: I love how this product is a makeup remover and a cleanser and smells amazing ! All in one tube !

I was pleasantly surprised by this product. I have never used a balm to remove makeup so I was a little skeptical but it surpassed all my expectations. The scent was light and refreshing and the product was easy to use. The balm does come out of the container rather thick but quickly melts into your hands and face. I felt that the thickness helped me with portion control when applied to my face. The makeup really did melt away and the balm was easy to wash off! My face felt so smooth clean and soft after just the first use! This product has truly made me a believe in balm makeup remover and I will definitely be buying it in the future. I would highly recommend if you are someone who likes the one and done of removing makeup and washing your face at night!

The Nudeskin Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt works great to take off my makeup and smells really good. I love the citrus apple mix and like than it is a balm. I definitely recommend this product and love the size which I can take with me during travel.

The cleanse this product leaves my skin is a truly amazing feeling. After one use of cleansing balm my skin was glowing and plump. I will definitely be making this a staple in my night routine. I love how I only have to clean once and the makeup is completely gone.

So I generally liked this product. The smell was amazing. I didn't experience burning in my eye areas but I also didn't have a ton of mascara I was trying to get off. I like double cleansing so I liked this product for the first step. My skin felt very clean after it. I will say though that my skin felt drier after double cleansing than it usually does.

avis.titre: I would get this product again
avis.texte: This is a good cleansing balm. It removed all of my makeup my face felt soft and clean. The only negative is the scent was a little too strong for me.

Having only ever used Cerave's makeup removing cleansing balm this make-up melt does pretty well in comparison. Truly melts all your makeup off and leaves your skin feeling fresh. The scent is nice but can be strong if you're sensitive to smells/fragrances. I would not spend full price on this product as it does leave skin feeling dry and it takes a decent amount of product to wash off a full-face of makeup not including eye makeup or lip products. If you have sensitive/dry skin it'd be better to opt for something more gentle. Overall the product does what it says and works well!

avis.titre: Good for a very limited audience
avis.texte: This product has some good some bad and some ugly. The good is that I found this removed my face makeup really well! The bad is that this is essentially an oil disguised as a balm - so this could be a tragedy for oily skin. But I wouldn't see this as a bad for dry skin. Nowthe ugly. This is absolutely not an eye-friendly product! I don't have sensitive skin but putting citrus in my eyes doesn't feel great. It also somehow finds its way to my mouth every time and ughhhuhhhuhh that's an unpleasant taste. Essentially I would only recommend this to someone who has dry skin and doesn't wear eye makeup.

It is so nice that is melts your makeup and washes your face at the same time. It is not drying and leaves my skin feeling clean and moisturized. I also like the scent and it isn't too over powering. The only cons I have found to this product is that it is pretty thick and hard to get out of the tube. It also can sting your eyes if you aren't careful. Overall I like it and I would purchase again.

avis.titre: A must-have in my skincare routine
avis.texte: This cleansing balm is a game-changer in my skincare routine! It effortlessly melts away makeup leaving my skin feeling refreshed and deeply cleansed. The citrus scent is invigorating and adds a delightful touch to the cleansing ritual. The formula is quite gentle and didn't irritate my skin. Highly recommended. I received the product for free in exchange for my honest review.
This product melted the makeup off of my skin and keeps it hydrated.

I really enjoy using cleansing balms and oil cleansers in my skincare routine so I was excited to try Nudestix's melt! This works great and does exactly what it says it does. I even used it on special effects makeup and it took away fake blood and heavy makeup so easily. I follow it with a water based cleanser to make sur I am really clean. It smells nice and goes on very soft. It melts down right away. It is a bit pricy but I recommend it.
Nice product that does what it's intended to do. It has a nice scent but is strong and irritated my eyes.

I love this Nudestix 4-1 cleansing balm. It has a thick greasy consistency but gets thinner as you massage it into your face and instantly removes makeup. Try not to get it into your eyes as it may cause a slight burning sensation. I was surprised at how well it cleaned as when I use my toner there is no residue left on my pad. My skin feels refreshed and hydrated after using this product. It also has a light citrusy scent that is not overpowering at all which is lovely. I highly recommend this product

avis.titre: Works great for foundation but burns the eyes.
avis.texte: This product smells so good! I wish they made a perfume. It made my skin feel so soft and helped remove my foundation. However burns my eyes if I get it too close so I won't be able to use this to remove eye makeup

Loved this product! It works effectively to melt make up and my skin feels nice and clean after. One note is to follow the instructions and apply it to dry skin- it didn't work as effectively when I applied it to already wet skin.
This cleansing balm is very gentle on my dry sensitive skin. It removes my makeup and SPF effectively. It doesn't make my skin feel dry or tight. Instead it is very moisturizing.
i really loved this product and the way it made my face feel. it helped melt off my makeup and i really enjoyed the smell and texture of it!

I love the way this feels on my face and once rinsed off it doesn't leave my skin dry. I just have to use micellar water to take off eye makeup because my eyes are sensitive. Overall a great product and would invest again!

I recently received the Nudestix Citrus Clean Balm and Make-Up Melt for free from Nudestix and Bzzagent to try out in exchange for my honest review. Smell good and nice to skin.I love the ingredients and also love the fact that the bottle and box is biodegradable. Overall the NudeStix Citrus Clean Balm and Make Up Melt is a must-have for anyone looking for a multi-functional product

avis.titre: This product is amazing for combination skin!
avis.texte: The makeup melt really came through when i had to take off heavy makeup that are usually extremely difficult to take off. It typically takes me 3 rounds of washing my face to get the heavy makeup off but with the makeup melt only had to wash my face ONCE!! My skin type is also combination and it didnt cause any irratation.

I love the citrusy scent of the balm it's like tropical heaven! Upon first look the packaging is cute but the thickness of the product makes it a little hard to dispense. It completely melted off my makeup and didn't dry out my skin. I liked it a lot!
I love this product! My face feels so fresh and clean after using this along with my regular skin care routine.
I really love this product to take my makeup off and using as a precleanse in my double cleanse skincare routine. Very effective and enjoyable to use.
This will now be a part of my routine when I remove my makeup! I will definitely be buying this now because it is my favorite thing it removes my makeup so well!

A very nice cleansing balm I love having this for when I travel the size is perfect for my carry on and my usual cleanser( oil cleanser) leaks all over the place so this is great! The consistency is very thick but a little goes a long way once you work the product with your fingers the consistency is much thinner. It does have a very strong citrus smell but I love it just be careful using it directly on your eyes. Eyeshadow is fine but careful with using it to remove mascara. Also love the packaging since the cleansing balms I've used all came in tubs I love the squeeze tube it's so mess free! Great product!

Loved it. I'm honestly a bit surprised that I really like this cleanser. The cleanser itself is greasy and I generally hate greasy things but it somehow does an amazing job of removing whatever is on your face. It also leaves you feeling hydrated. Some folks say it leaves a residue which I think is just hydration but I did follow it with a toner sometimes and that seemed to take care of the residue. I also really like that you apply it to a dry face. I think that helps with makeup removal and it saves water.
I love that this product is a balm and removes makeup. I use this as a double cleanser to make sure the makeup is all off and my skin is clean.

It took off my make up but I felt like I had to wash my face twice after to get the film ofit was pretty thick which I did like! It made my eyes burn and tear up when I was using it around my eye area to remove mascara so that is a con for me. I wouldn't rush to buy it but I wouldn't be opposed to having this around either.

I used this product to remove makeup as directed. I found it easy to work with left my skin soft and supple and the scent was strong but pleasant. I don't mind fragrance in my products so I enjoyed. The remover was effective in removing my makeup.

This is probably the thickest cleansing balm I've used. Slightly reminds me of Vaseline texture wise. As for cleaning it did a pretty good job! My water proof mascara did take a bit of extra effort but the rest of my face was easily makeup free and actually felt clean but not dry or stripped.

The clean balm works great to remove the makeup and make my skin feel clean and fresh. Cute packaging and a subtle citrusy scent. The only thing I don't like is the texture is so thick making it hard to get out of the bottle.

I love this product! It has a nice citrus smell and a very thick consistency. It cleaned all my makeup without a problem except of my waterproof eyeliner but it's like 95% gone on the first wash. Honestly I didn't have a product that clean it 100% after just one wash. It leaves skin nice and soft. It didnt hurt my eyes. You can still smell it after washing it off but I really like the smell so it's not a problem for me. Really great product that helps remove makeup really quickly

I wish the packaging was different because it's hard to get some of the product out without ruining the tube. I really enjoyed the smell of the rosehip oil. It's has an oily feeling when you work it down to melt. It got all my makeup and I felt moisturized.

I got this a few months ago, i was looking for a makeup melting balm and this product did its job.. i wouldnt buy again tho just bc it did burn my eyes, i have tried other melting balms that dont do it but i wanted to try this one. The smell is good and refreshing on the skin but even after rinsing off it leave face a bit greasy which i dont particularly like the feeling.

Navigating the tricky world of skincare with my ultra-sensitive skin has always felt like a high-stakes game until I stumbled upon the Citrus Cleansing Balm & Makeup Melt. This little miracle in a tube completely changed the game for me! It kisses all my makeup goodbye melting it away with such finesse and gentleness that my skin breathes a sigh of relief every time. Not a hint of irritation just pure soft and luminous skin left behind. It's the hero my skincare routine never knew it needed vegan cruelty-free and oh-so-kind to my delicate skin. What's not to love?

I honestly didn't think this product was going to work. Boy was I wrong. I love how efficient and easy this product is to use. One if the best make up removers I have ever tried My daughter also loves it. The only thing I don't care for is it can feel a little grease but still a amazing product!!
I love this product! smells great, goes on like a dream, moisturizing and leaves a clean finish. worth the $

I am in LOVE with this product! It's a 4 in 1 Product - Olive Oil based makeup remover skin cleanser skin softener and skin brighter. Only a pea-sized amount of product is needed to remove all makeup and leave my skin feeling soft fresh and smelling amazing!! I love the citrus smell it's not overpowering at all and because of all the natural ingredients I love using it on my skin. It is rich in Vitamin A includes May Chang Oil Citrus Essential Oil Orange Peel Oil Rosemary Leaf Oil Eucalyptus Oil Chia Seed Oil Lavender Oil Bitter Orange Flower Apple Fruit Extract to name a few. The balm melts easily as soon as it touches the skin. I love that I can do 4 steps in one and wash my face right after use without having to use an additional cleanser. It leaves my face feeling refreshed and moisturized. I noticed a huge difference in the texture of my skin minimized my pores and sebum and hydration of my face since using this everyday for a couple of weeks. It has replaced 4 products I was using and I couldn't be happier with my results. I use this everyday and it's a MUST HAVE product!

This product is absolutely wonderful for rmoving stubborn makeup. my waterproof mascara has nothjng on it. but the fragrance is just so strong that it hurts my eyes. i keep coming back to because i cant find anythjng else better

avis.titre: Love this product amazing for dry skin!
avis.texte: I started using this product recently and love the smell and overall feel of the product! It's very effective at removing makeup and feels so luxurious!
I love that this is a 4 in 1 product this makes my skin care routine more simplified.
This product was great to remove makeup I followed it up with a cleanser and felt fresher than ever

The NudeStix Citrus Clean Balm and Make-Up Melt is an exceptional product that delivers four different benefits in just one tube a make-up remover skin cleanser skin softener and skin brightener. The balm has a delightful texture that feels fantastic on the skin and it's an absolute game-changer for people on the go who prefer a one-and-done product.The product is vegan fragrance-free and doesn't contain any parabens or sulfates. It contains Apple fruit extract which is an excellent antioxidant that protects the skin and contains a natural malic acid (AHA) that works wonders for deep cleansing. The lavender oil has a calming effect and the Neroli oil (bitter orange flower) provides lightweight hydration.The cleansing properties of the balm come from the Chang oil a citrus oil that helps to purify the skin and the orange peel oil which energizes the skin for a natural-looking glow. The Rosemary Leaf oil tones the skin and helps improve the appearance of congested pores while the Eucalyptus Leaf oil clarifies the skin making it appear more radiant.To use this product apply it every morning as a daily cleanser or at night to watch your makeup melt right off. It's gentle enough to remove eye makeup without any irritation and it leaves your skin feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. The citrusy scent is a perfect pick-me-up in the morning and it's a great way to start your day.Overall the NudeStix Citrus Clean Balm and Make Up Melt is a must-have for anyone looking for a multi-functi

I love this product I have been searching for a good cleansing balm and I found it! It's very gentle and removes even the toughest makeup! My daughter dances and it removes her stage makeup effortlessly.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: After a day of wearing makeup I like to use the Citrus Clean Balm & Makeup Melt to help remove what is left on my face. I pair it with a reusable makeup pad and it makes makeup removal super easy! My skin is left feeling smooth and bright and dewy.

I absolutely loved this product not only did it remove all of my makeup really well but it also helped to brighten my skin. This vegan product was very gentle on my skin didn't leave it looking dry after using it and made a huge difference in the softness of my skin as well. It comes in a tube which made for an easy application without having any mess I will definitely continue to use this product regularly and recommend especially if your someone who wears makeup on a daily basis. It has made my skin care routine that much easier as it's a 4-in-1 product so can combat all of the things you need it to do at the end of your long busy day.

avis.titre: Works great even on hard to remove makeup
avis.texte: I found this product worked very well. It easily took off hard to remove makeup that soap and water alone can't remove. It takes off waterproof makeup as well. A little goes a long way. It's a little oily at first but it does wash away easily.

avis.titre: Magically melts makeup away while cleansing & soft
avis.texte: I am already such a fan of NUDESTIX so I was excited to hear about their NUDESKIN line of products. Recently I discovered the Citrus Cleansing Balm & Makeup Melt and I am absolutely smitten with it! This citrus-infused cleansing balm removes all of my makeup and visibly cleanses my skin and let me tell you my skin is looking so much better since I have incorporated this 4-in-1 into my routine! It's not only a makeup remover but it also cleanses softens and brightens skin! I have used it every other day for the past two weeks and my skin is looking more even-textured brighter and free of whiteheads or clogged pores. It smells fresh and delicious containing hints of orange peel oil apple fruit extract and rosehip fruit oil. I cannot believe how much it has helped my skin. I cannot wait to try other products from this line and have already recommended this 4-in-1 Citrus Cleansing Balm & Makeup Melt to my friends with similar skin to mine. Lastly I love that it is cruelty-free vegan synthetic fragrance-free (yay no headaches!) and formulated without parabens sulfates and phthalates and the packaging is eco-friendly. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
Love this product. The smell and texture is great and glides over skin while removing all makeup. I will definitely be purchasing to add to my skincare routine.

I received this for free to test and give my honest opinion. The first thing I noticed was how cute and clean the packaging appeared. When I opened the package to use it. The sneak was so awesome! It smells like lemons. So fresh. It melts into your skin and doesn't leave a greasy feeling. I noticed that my skin started to look better and brighter after a few days. I was really happy with how quickly you noticed a difference on your skin. I found that if I did miss a day that my skin lost the shine and it is quite pricey for the little amount you get.

avis.titre: New add on for my routine!
avis.texte: Delivers what it promises! Literally melts the makeup off. I have been very impressed with this product. Used it to remove waterproof mascara and eyeliner. All in all great!

Not the first product I run to but whenever I have stubborn makeup or want a fresh start throughout the day it removes my makeup so well! Took off a stubborn red lip and waterproof mascara with no problem!

This balm is very effective at removing makeup. It smells strongly of lemon candy which could be a positive or negative. It can be a little tough to squeeze out of the tube but the consistency is good once you get it out of your hands and thins out easily to wash off quicker.

avis.titre: Decent for on the go but not as part of a regimen
avis.texte: This product was alright generally but at the end of the day it felt like a barrier to my serum routine and burned my eyes when I tried to wash it off. Packaging: The product itself is packaged in a tube that holds its form well. It was easy to squeeze and held its shape but I worried that when the tube got to the bottom it might crack and leak. This tube is packaged in a clear plastic case that appears to only serve the purpose in telling that the clear plastic case was biodegradable. The Product: Yellow in colour with a soft wax texture. It smells kind of chemically lemon like cleaning product. Application: Went on smooth and actually dissolved the makeup! Even the waterproof liner and mascara. I was actually impressed. It did its job. After: The instructions said you could leave it as is after rubbing it in or washing it off with warm water. Considering I have a serum routine I decided to wash and continue with my daily regimen. This was a problem. When I washed it off with warm water it made the skin around my eyes burn and go red. It was completely fine if I didn't add water (and the following night I just left it on and while it didn't burn my eyes it did feel greasy and I didn't like that). Adding serums on top of this thick waxy layer seemed like a waste of money. Final thoughts: Would this be good for my daily wash? No. I don't think so. It feels like it creates a barrier to the additional products. When it would be good is when I'm traveling as it would be less like

Product was amazing. The scent is incredible very fresh. While it will defintiely remove your make up the only downside is that while it is also ment to be a face wash I still used a secondary cleanser as it did leave a bit of an oily residue if I was to only use this item. However it still works fantastic and I loved using it. Packaging is also adorable.

This makeup remover is a four in one multipurpose product it removes makeup cleans skin and makes it smooth and bright. It suited my sensitive skin well and has a very pleasant and refreshing aroma. Would recommend it to everyone.

I love this product. It's smells so nice. It feels absolutely amazing on my skin. You don't need a lot of product for it to work. Melts your makeup right off without leaving your skin feeling greasy. I don't recommend it to remove mascara because if you accidentally get it in your eyes it stings really bad.

avis.titre: This product did what it needed to do
avis.texte: This product worked really well at getting all of my water proof make up off but I found it really stung my eyes. Over all it does work great throug
Melted my makeup away and removed even waterproof mascara. Highly recommended and has a light scent.
I love the scent of this and it removes makeup well leaving your face feeling hydrated!

I recently received the Nudestix Citrus Clean Balm and Make-Up Melt for free from Nudestix and Bzzagent to try out in exchange for my honest review.I've been such a huge fan of Nudestix products since trying them out for the first time and I knew this cleansing balm wasn't going to disappoint.Love the packaging to start with it's cute it's simple and it's sanitary. Often times cleansing balms come in a jar which may not be as sanitary with the constant finger scooping or dipping but Nudestix thought it through and put it in a tube so you can easily control the amount you need while keeping the rest of the product clean.The cleansing balm smells very lemon-y which may or may not be your thing but I absolutely love lemon anything so this was right up my alley. The balm itself is on the softer side and just melts into the skin once it comes into contact with heat. It takes off my makeup so easily (even waterproof mascara)! It's recommended that you either wipe it off or wash it off I opt with the latter method and then do a second cleanse with my regular facial cleanser.The only downside I would say is that the amount of the product you get is less compared to regular cleansing balms on the market so hopefully Nudestix comes out with a larger size in the future!I will definitely be repurchasing this once I run out! Highly recommend!
I love how this makes the makeup melt and is easy to wipe off. It is a very innovative product and I have never seen any other product that does this.

I recently received the Nudestix Nudeskin Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt in return for an honest review. My skin get irritated easily so i did a test pacth frist. A little goes a long way and it works really well. The results are amazing leaves skin feeling so soft. Definitely recommend

I used this to take my makeup off at the end of the day. It cleaned really well and got my waterproof mascara off easily. I like that it also has a cleanser in it and makes your skin soft. It's smells really good too!

I had the opportunity to try this product for free in exchange for providing my review. To be honest I'd never heard of a make-up melt and was surprised to see how thick the product is. While I don't wear a ton of make-up since the pandemic began I do often wear waterproof mascara. This clean balm and make-up melt did remove quite a bit of the mascara but there was still some that remained which actually happens with many of the products I use so this is no different. I usually buy unscented products as many scented products bother my (perfumed) allergies. I love the scent of this though and it's not a trigger to my allergies which is amazing. I haven't used the entire tube of this yet and imagine that it will take me quite a while. I would possibly purchase it again but the price point is quite high compared to other make-up removers and cleaners I use. We'll see.

I really liked the idea of this and would definitely keep in my repitoir for when I can't do a complete skin care regime at night. It smells so good and feels nice and soft. It doesn't take long at all to remove your makeup. It doesn't completely get rid of mascara but I just go in with an eye wipe after. I find it does feel a little bit greasy at the end but also leaves my skin feeling soft. I would definitely buy this product again for those days when I just wanna quickly wash my makeup off and hop into bed. It's a great product with an incredible smell.

Nudeskin Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt is awesome! It removes all makeup while also leaving my skin soft and hydrated. I love the scent to this balm and also the packaging. I used to use makeup wipes to remove makeup but this will definitely be replacing them. Highly recommend!

I wasn't sure what this product would be like as I had never heard of a make-up melt or balm.The product comes out of the tube like a thick wax but melts to an oil as you rub it in your hands or on your face. I used it to take my make-up off at the end of the day including from my eyes. I massaged it all over and then wiped it off with a wet cloth. All the make-up came off very quick including eyeliner and mascara. My face is a bit hot afterwards and I was worried it was reacting but it faded quickly.

avis.titre: This cleanser is on my repurchase list
avis.texte: I love the convenient packaging of the Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt. It doesn't take up a lot of real estate in my bathroom compared to a large tub of makeup remover and only a small amount is needed. I also appreciate that I don't have to stick my fingers in the tub and potentially contaminate the product. It feels more sanitary being in a tube. Only a small amount is needed which is nice but it can be a a little tricky to squeeze out as it's so thick. I loved how soft my face feels after I use the Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Melt. It's not the best for eye makeup as it's almost too greasy for that but it took off my face makeup really well. I would repurchase this product.
